title: Trader

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Traders are NPCs that sell items in exchange for Coins. They can also exchange valuables for coins.
There are three traders:
• Haldor found in the Black Forest.
• Hildir found in the Meadows.
• The Bog Witch found in the Swamp.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: There can only be one merchant of each type in a world. Each trader has multiple possible spawn locations. Approaching any of these locations will permanently place the trader there. This can happen from 320 to 453 meters away (about twice of the default minimap range) when the related Zones are generated. When discovered, the trader icon will appear on the world map.

sections.heading: Valuables
sections.text:
Valuables is a category of items which can be exchanged for Coins at any of the traders.
There is no price difference between traders and they all accept all valuables. Once sold, valuable items cannot be bought back from traders.

full_text:
Trader

Introduction. Traders are NPCs that sell items in exchange for Coins. They can also exchange valuables for coins.
There are three traders:
• Haldor found in the Black Forest.
• Hildir found in the Meadows.
• The Bog Witch found in the Swamp.

Location. There can only be one merchant of each type in a world. Each trader has multiple possible spawn locations. Approaching any of these locations will permanently place the trader there. This can happen from 320 to 453 meters away (about twice of the default minimap range) when the related Zones are generated. When discovered, the trader icon will appear on the world map.

Valuables. Valuables is a category of items which can be exchanged for Coins at any of the traders.
There is no price difference between traders and they all accept all valuables. Once sold, valuable items cannot be bought back from traders.
